author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
Indie Games are fantastic! When a solo video game developer release a new game I, The Spiffing brit, Get to test them out and do my classic perfectly balanced survey where I hunt for Bugs, Glitches, Exploits and overpowered gameplay mechanics that can be broken to create some absurd situations. In This case I wanted to Speedrun a new game called There Are No Orcs and see how using a combination of Overpowered mechanics and broken exploits to glitch infinite health, infinite damage and infinite attack speed onto a crossbowman.
